note: Adapted from the species-level description of Krishna & Adams (1982); original in English; the original diagnosis refers only to the key and to the comparative section, from which the diagnostic characters are taken; only the soldier is known, worker and alate not seen; measurements from the holotype and range values; type locality, collection records and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier resembles L. kistneri but has a smaller head, smaller mandibles and a narrower labral base; it differs from L. buttel-reepeni in the more rounded sides of the head (subparallel in the latter) and in the more abruptly curved left mandible.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, anterior margin around the mandibles brown; postclypeus yellowish brown; antennae white to pale yellow; mandibles shiny brown, becoming paler towards the base to yellowish brown; labrum pale brown, with a white translucent median lobe; pronotum pale yellow. Head and postmentum rather densely covered with short setae and hairs; pronotum with a few setae and hairs; labrum with setae of three lengths, the longest about 0.15 mm. Sides of head very weakly rounded, gradually narrowed anteriorly, posterior part broadly rounded, oval in lateral view; fontanelle small, circular. Labrum enlarged, with a crescent-shaped translucent lobe; tilted upwards, trilobed, margins of each lobe convex dorsally; sides rounded; sclerotized process on the posterior middle of the ventral surface angular. Mandibles about half as long as head. Outer margin of left mandible straighter than that of right mandible but gently curved towards the apex; inner margin with a very small pointed process at the base, followed by a larger, blunter tooth with a concave surface, then three gradually diminishing teeth and numerous fine blunt serrations extending to the apex. Outer margin of right mandible abruptly curved from base to apex, dorsal side of inner margin flat; a narrow groove from near the base to the apex, ventral edge of the groove finely serrate; one or two very small points below the basal tooth. Antennae 12-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal in length, the remaining segments longer. Anterior part of postmentum oval, narrowing posteriorly to a minimum width and then widening again, constriction index 0.50–0.56. Pronotum about half as wide as head, anterior lobe with a shallow median cleft. Head length 1.04 mm, maximum head width 0.65 mm, right mandible length 0.55 mm, left mandible length 0.60 mm.
